title: Christopher Alexander - Patterns in Architecture
summary: Christopher Alexander's keynote at OOPSLA 1996 on patterns in architecture, addressed to the software community. He moves beyond patterns toward deeper ideas of wholeness and living structure.
why: HN cites it as the primary source for the claim that Alexander deprecated patterns, and as a prescient talk for programmers.

quote.text: Just finished watching a great 1996 lecture by Christopher Alexander
